text:
Priya Nair: heads-up - partner release artifact (private-registry) included a config.tar.gz containing `~/.vault-token`. Found during routine repo scan. Token scopes looked elevated. We need containment + rotation.
Marco Diaz: ugh. Which pipeline produced the artifact? Any external pulls?
Anya Patel: artifact came from partner-ci-build-12. It's in gcr.io/partner-artifacts/redwood/ingest:20260320. Access logs show internal pulls only, but we can't trust partner infra.
Samir Kapoor: token scope: policy allowed secret/* on staging and access to vault transit/rewrap. They may have used it to wrap with our KMS key. Need to assume potential misuse.
Priya Nair: immediate checklist: 1) revoke the token and any associated SA keys, 2) rotate Vault secret versions implicated, 3) rotate/rotate-wrap KMS key if transit keys might be compromised, 4) enable extended audit exports to BigQuery and save evidence, 5) update RBAC to remove transit write for partner role.
Brenda Li: I'll take #1 and #4. Which KMS key alias?
Anya Patel: KMS alias used for vault auto-unseal: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/vault/cryptoKeys/vault-unseal. Transit key alias: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/transit/cryptoKeys/vault-transit.
Marco Diaz: quick clarification: rotating the KMS unseal key is a big deal (unseal depends on it). We should prefer rewrapping secrets and rotating transit keys first, avoid rekeying auto-unseal unless we have to.
Samir Kapoor: agree. We should do: rewrap affected ciphertexts with a new key version for transit and create a new KMS keyversion for transit (not the unseal key). Leave auto-unseal alone for now.
Priya Nair: good call. Anya, can you list affected Vault paths?
Anya Patel: found reads/writes to secret/data/staging/partner/* and secret/data/shared/ingest-api within the token audit window. I'll export the list.
vault-bot: Audit events exported: `bq://redwood_audit.vault_exports.316778`
Brenda Li: revoking token now: `vault token revoke <token>` and rotating partner service account keys in GCP. Also disabled partner CI's registry push until they rotate keys.
Marco Diaz: RBAC change: I've drafted a policy that removes `transit/encrypt` and `transit/rewrap` from the partner vault policy and restricts secret paths to `secret/data/staging/partner/*` read-only. Tagging @infra for rollout.
Priya Nair: timeline: containment now, rewrap + transit key version rotation at 22:00 UTC, secret rotate at 22:15 (canary), full rotate by 22:30. Any objections?
Samir Kapoor: none. I'll prepare a rewrap script: `vault write -f transit/rewrap ciphertext=@ciphertext` with new key version alias `vault-transit-v2`. We'll create new key version in KMS and update vault-transit key config to use new version for encrypt/decrypt.
Anya Patel: to be safe, I will snapshot all current ciphertexts for the affected paths and save to `gs://redwood-sec-evidence/316778/snapshots/` before rewrap.
Brenda Li: evidence exports to BigQuery complete and I've also enabled a 60d retention on the audit dataset. Creating a signed manifest and uploading to evidence bucket.
Marco Diaz: one more operational note: if partner token was used to call transit/rewrap, there will be audit entries showing rewrap requests. We'll correlate request IDs with KMS key versions.
Priya Nair: compliance ask: we must produce a timeline and signed evidence for our SOC report. Brenda, include who revoked, times, and SHA256 of artifact.
Brenda Li: adding SHA256 of the artifact and GPG-signing the manifest now.
Samir Kapoor: rewrap started at 22:00 UTC. Canary rewrap of two secrets completed at 22:07. No errors.
Anya Patel: secret rotation (canary) completed at 22:18 UTC. Updated application credentials and tested ingest -> success.
Marco Diaz: rolled RBAC policy changes at 22:25 UTC. Partner role no longer has transit write. Confirmed via `vault policy read partner-role` diff.
Brenda Li: full rotate finished at 22:31 UTC. Evidence bundle uploaded `gs://redwood-sec-evidence/316778/manifest.gpg`. Audit logs show the revoked token and all subsequent failed attempts.
Priya Nair: post-incident actions: 1) ban plaintext tokens from artifacts (CI lint), 2) require vault-agent with mutating admission webhook for k8s, 3) add automated scan of container images for dotfiles containing tokens, 4) schedule partner remediation call and contract clause update. I've opened the postmortem and assigned owners.
Marco Diaz: also add an alert for "vault-token leaked to artifact registry" pattern. Samir, can you add that to infra-alerting?
Samir Kapoor: on it. I'll add a regex-based scanner and an alert that triggers paging.
Anya Patel: partner notified and given 48h to provide remediation plan. They're cooperating.
Priya Nair: thanks team. Closing thread once postmortem is linked. Keep the evidence bucket read-only for now.
